# Malachi Chapter 4 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/MAL_004_page_001.jpg

---

**4:2** "But-for-you who-fear [yirei] my-name, the-sun [shemesh] of-righteousness [tsedaqah] will-rise [vezarchah] with-healing [u-marpei] in-its-wings [bi-khnafeyha]; and-you-will-go-out [vi-ytsatem] and-frisk [u-fishshtem] like-calves [ke-eglei] of-the-stall [marbeq]."

**4:5** "Behold, I [am] sending [shole'ach] to-you Eliyyah [Elijah] the-prophet [ha-navi] before the-coming [bo] of-the-day of-YHWH, the-great [ha-gadol] and-the-terrible [veha-nora]."

**4:6** "And-he-will-turn [veheshiv] the-heart [lev] of-fathers [avot] to [the] sons [al-banim] and-the-heart of-sons to their-fathers [al-avotam], lest [pen] I-come [avo] and-strike [vehikkeiti] the-land [ha-arets] with-a-ban [cherem]."
